candidates.change_summary: Replace returned slot with a different constant (returns ADMIN_SLOT instead of IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT).

Invert the delegation check to allow only non-proxy context (revert when address(this) == __self or implementation matches __self), changing notDelegated behavior so proxiableUUID call under delegatecall may now succeed/return different value.
Removed the call to __UUPSUpgradeable_init() inside C.initialize, so only __Access_init is executed during initialization.
Change the initializer modifier to set _initialized to 2 instead of 1, altering recorded initialized version after initialization.
When computing utilization from index and elapsed, remove the division by elapsed so utilization becomes (index - previousIndex) instead of rate per second, changing returned rate.
If block.timestamp equals lastUpdate, use stored index difference instead of calling IVault.utilization, changing returned value path.
If elapsed is zero after computing it, force utilization to vault's reported utilization to avoid division effects (inserting a conditional assignment).
Replace the kink validation to allow kink == 0 by removing the check for zero (only disallow kink >= 1e27). This changes accepted slope inputs and therefore stored slopeData after setSlopes.
Invert the comparison so the function reverts when kink < 1e27 instead of when kink >= 1e27, changing which slope values are accepted and thus the stored slopes.
Delete the validation entirely by removing the if-revert check so any kink value (including invalid extremes) is accepted and written to storage.
Change the storage write to store only slope0 and slope1, leaving kink unchanged (so post-call stored kink differs from original behavior).
After validation, swap the order: emit the event before updating storage, so the emitted event reflects old stored values rather than the new ones.
